partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Compact cellular-component causal module
results.hypothesis: A drug can treat a disease when it directly inhibits one causal gene that shares a compact cellular component with a second causal disease gene.
results.body: drug binds and decreases causal gene; second causal gene shares p90-compact GO cellular component
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule links directional drug action to two causal genes in a discrete molecular assembly, providing complex-level mechanism beyond pairwise interaction.
results.trapi_notes: The target and component paths are TRAPI-expressible; distinct-gene identity, component degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene1)-[:PART_OF]->(component:CellularComponent)
      <-[:PART_OF]-(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE gene2 <> gene1
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND component._miner_component_gene_member_degree <= 54
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Dual-inhibition cellular-component causal module
results.hypothesis: A compact component mechanism is strongest when the drug directly binds and decreases two causal genes in the same molecular assembly.
results.body: drug binds and decreases two causal genes sharing p90-compact GO cellular component
results.mechanism_rationale: Two directional target arms converge on a discrete causal molecular assembly, yielding a specific nonlinear mechanism despite missing disease-activity direction.
results.trapi_notes: The repeated target and component paths are TRAPI-expressible; two-target cardinality, component degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene1)-[:PART_OF]->(component:CellularComponent)
      <-[:PART_OF]-(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND component._miner_component_gene_member_degree <= 54
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
